name: @caotang/import-xlsx
description: The Excel workbook reader for the spreadsheet import (#289): xl/workbook.xml, shared strings, inline strings, cached formula values and dates in the 1900 or 1904 system, read on the shared zip and XML layer into the same grid the CSV reader maps. No SheetJS, no DOM, no third-party dependency; runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
